candidate.definition_en: To state an intention to harm or punish someone, or to be likely to cause damage or danger to something.
candidate.explanation_ar: يُهدد بإلحاق الأذى أو العقاب بشخص ما، أو يشكّل خطراً يهدد بحدوث مشكلة أو ضرر.

senses.definition_en: To tell someone that you will harm, kill, or punish them if they do not do what you want.
examples: Don't threaten me with legal action.

senses.definition_en: To be likely to damage, destroy, or endanger something.
senses.definition_ar: يعرّض شيئاً للخطر أو ينذر بوقوع ضرر.
examples: Rising sea levels threaten coastal communities around the world.
These budget cuts threaten to disrupt public services.
Don't threaten me with legal action.
Rising sea levels threaten coastal communities around the world.
These budget cuts threaten to disrupt public services.
